//: Type-checks the test suite, which `tsconfig.json` never did.
has never examined a single file in `tests/`. Every 'tsc is clean' claim made against
this repo was therefore blind to the test suite — which is where the real damage lives.
Concretely: an unbalanced brace in tests/jfk.test.ts that closed a `describe` early,
and a `localTime` reference that fell out of scope, both compiled invisibly and were
caught only because ts-jest type-checks each file it runs.
`rootDir` is deliberately not inherited as `src`: including `tests/**/*` under that
rootDir is TS6059 in every file, which is a build-layout complaint rather than a type
error and would mask real ones. There is no `outDir` here because this config is only
ever used with --noEmit; the shipped build continues to use tsconfig.json unchanged.
